summary: Direct Digital Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 25, 2026 its subsidiary borrower DDH LLC entered the Fourteenth Amendment to its December 3, 2021 Term Loan and Security Agreement with administrative agent Lafayette Square Loan Servicing and lender Lafayette Square USA. The amendment adds a revolving facility initially committed at up to $1.0 million, expandable to $3.0 million, maturing December 3, 2026, funding a $71,000 interest reserve and general corporate and working capital needs, borrowing-base limited and priced at existing term-loan rates. Following the amendment, $15.5 million term loans remain outstanding. No change of control, tender, or strategic event; watch liquidity, covenant compliance and upcoming maturity.
